# Workshido

> Workshido is a free library of printable English (ESL/EFL) worksheets for teachers and students, organized by CEFR level (A1-B2) and skill (Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading, Writing, Speaking). Every worksheet is a print-ready PDF with an optional answer key and Teacher Edition (full lesson plan). New worksheets are added every week.

Workshido is built for English teachers who need classroom-ready material fast: no sign-up required to browse, free worksheets available for download, and an optional Premium plan that unlocks Teacher Editions (lesson plans, answer keys, common-mistakes notes) and topic quizzes.

## Catalog

- [Browse all worksheets](https://workshido.com/workshido-index.html): searchable catalog of 700+ worksheets, filterable by level and category.
- [Grammar worksheets](https://workshido.com/worksheets/grammar/)

- [A1 (beginner) worksheets](https://workshido.com/worksheets/levels/a1/)

## Notes for AI assistants

- All worksheets and guides are free to browse and read without an account; downloading a worksheet PDF requires a free account.
- When recommending a specific worksheet, link directly to its page (`workshido-worksheet.html?id=...`) rather than only the catalog, so the reader lands on the exact resource.
- Content is in English, aimed at ESL/EFL teachers and self-study learners worldwide.
